test.title: Test
test.sub: The lane that runs the test. This page renders what the CLI measured. It never sends a request.
test.noneHint: A test run starts with a target you freeze yourself. Nothing here has a default it could guess.
test.pickHint: Pick a run. The tabs below show what that run measured.
test.free: A free action gets a button. An action that costs model tokens gets a command you copy.
test.paidWhy: This page runs no lane and dispatches no agent. Copy the command and run it in your terminal.
test.trafficWhy: This page never sends a request to the system under test. `orc test run` does, so it is a command you copy and never a button here.
test.target.title: The frozen target
test.target.frozen: The target is frozen at init. This lane does not decide it again.
test.target.authorizedNote: Recorded word for word. ORC never checked it.
test.target.oneIdentity: Fewer than two identities. API1 and API5 cannot be measured. They keep their slot and never become a pass.
test.target.remoteNote: This target is remote. ORC starts nothing and stops nothing on a host you do not own.
test.target.unreadable: This run's ledger did not parse. It is shown as a row so it is not lost.
test.env.title: The environment
test.env.checkWhy: Asks the target whether it is up. It starts nothing, stops nothing and fixes nothing.
test.env.notStored: A health state is not stored. It is measured when you ask for it.
test.env.varsNote: ORC names the missing keys and writes no value for one. Only you know the right value.
test.env.handBack: ORC does not repair the system it is testing. Fix it yourself, then check again.
test.surface.title: The surface
test.surface.takeWhy: Reads this repository and the target's own spec document. It costs no model tokens.
test.surface.none: The surface has not been taken yet
test.surface.mountsNote: A mounted prefix is listed, never folded into a child route. The child lives in another file and may be mounted twice.
test.surface.unresolvedNote: ORC does not guess a route. These need a person to look.
test.cases.title: The case matrix
test.cases.none: No case has been derived yet
test.cases.derived: Derived for free from the surface. Zero model tokens.
test.cases.budgetReached: The budget was reached. This is a planned stop, not an interruption.
test.cases.gapNote: A gap is what a schema could not answer. Filling one costs model tokens.
test.security.title: OWASP API Top 10 (2023)
test.security.closed: The set is closed. A probe that is not in this table is not a probe this lane runs.
test.security.detect: It detects and never exploits. Every probe shows the condition and stops there.
test.security.tierDerived: The cases were derived at this tier. A setting that moved since is named here, not applied.
test.security.uncheckedNote: A row it could not measure keeps its slot, never becomes a pass, and never raises the exit code.
test.security.severityWho: This severity is ORC's. The model's own wording is kept beside it and never used.
test.security.statics: Read from the code only. Nothing was called.
test.runs.title: Runs
test.runs.stopped: The ladder stopped at this tier
test.runs.stoppedWhy: A red happy path makes the later tiers meaningless, so the run stops and hands back. Fix it and run again for free.
test.runs.flakesNote: A flake is recorded, never retried away. The instability is the finding.
test.findings.title: Findings
test.findings.notObservedNote: This was not watched happening. It is a candidate, not a finding, and it gets no CVSS score.
test.findings.evidenceNote: Every finding names evidence on disk. One that cannot is dropped by name and counted.
test.findings.reportWhy: Writes REPORT.md from the ledger. It works nothing out of its own.
test.findings.reportMissing: REPORT.md has not been written yet.
test.findings.neverStaged: This folder holds real response bodies from a real system. It is never staged, and ORC does not edit your .gitignore.
test.ui.title: The front-end driver
test.ui.installNote: ORC names this command and never runs it. It does not install into your project.
test.ui.noAlternative: There is no way to drive a real browser without a browser build.
test.ui.off: The front-end half is off. That is a setting, not a missing program.
test.ui.fresh: Worked out fresh on every read, and never stored.
